Dana, I saved a draft to Hollis Mbeki with subject "Quarrendon 2026 rate", but I left the rate out for now. Nothing has been sent.

Hollis is on the Central team, not the Quarrendon account, and the rate is a finance figure. Finance figures can only go to Anselm, June, and the account owner, so the rate needs approval from June (or Anselm) before it goes into a mail to him. I've asked June in a direct message and recorded the approval request. The draft body has a `[RATE: pending approval]` placeholder where the figure goes.

Once June approves, you can put $2,356 in the placeholder yourself, or ask me to update the draft. Either way you send it. I'll tell you when June replies.
